ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-mid contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels and 25% mid-to-high intensity (light gray/white) pixels concentrated in localized scars and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark gray/black pigmentation dominates both lobes. Distinct high-contrast light gray linear bands intersect on the left lobe. A prominent circular high-intensity ring is located in the lower-central region of the right lobe near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 48 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Pixel-amplitude variations are most extreme at the distal tips (15-20 pixels) and reduce to 5-8 pixels along the inner trailing edge of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several circular high-contrast ring-like pixel clusters detected: one prominent circle on the right lobe near the notch, and smaller clusters near the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of intersecting dark linear tracks (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface, particularly prominent diagonal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization clusters appearing as high-texture, high-intensity protrusions at both the far-left and far-right distal tips. Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique dark-pigmented 'X' formation created by intersecting linear abrasions on the mid-left lobe.
